title: Ascension Hymn to the Skies (Jingrwai Ban Kiew Sha Bneng)
cultural_context: Solemn eschatological hymn singing of the spiritual homecoming when the righteous soul ascends to the golden realm beyond the clouds, from 'Ki Jingrwai Ai-nguh Blei'.

khasi: Nga peit sha kliar ki lum ba jrong,
Sha khet ba phyrnai u Blei ha suiñ;
Nga kwah ban kiew sha lyndet ki lyoh,
Sha shnong ba kyntang ka jingsuk;
Hangta kam don shuh ka jingpang jingiap,
Ki ummat kin jah baroh phar;
U Blei Un pdiang ia la ki khun
Ha ka burom ba phuh ba neh.
english: I gaze toward the summits of the highest peaks,
Unto the radiant throne of God in heaven;
I yearn to ascend beyond the shining mists,
Unto the sacred city of eternal peace;
There sickness and mortal death are known no more,
All sorrowful tears shall be wiped away;
God shall welcome His faithful children
Into glory that blossoms and endures forever.

khasi: Katba nga dang im ha kane ka ri,
Ngan rwai ia ka nam jong U Blei;
Ngan kamai ia ka hok da ka mynsiem ba khuid,
Ban pynkhreh ia la ka lynti;
Haba ka por kan poi ban khlad,
Ban shong ha pneh U Nongthaw
Ha ka jingshai ba kynja blei.
english: While I still dwell within this mortal realm,
I shall sing the praises of Almighty God;
I shall earn righteousness with an unspotted heart,
To prepare my destined pathway home;
When the hour arrives for me to depart,
I shall ascend without trembling or dread;
To rest in the embrace of the Creator
In the everlasting light of heaven.

vocabulary.kiew sha bneng: ascend unto heaven / return to the skies
